shapes.name: TrackerField
shapes.doc: One value a tracker keeps. The first four are the field basics a tool's argument shares (entities/_shared/field-schema.ts).

fields.name: name
fields.meaning: A lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits and _.

fields.name: choices
fields.meaning: The allowed values of a choice field; only a choice field has them.

fields.name: maxField
fields.meaning: Number only, and not with `max`: the name of another number field of this tracker whose current value is this field's top (hp out of hp_max). A value above it is brought down to it, never refused.

fields.name: icon
fields.meaning: A well-formed icon id (`lucide:name` or `mdi:name`); absent means no icon. Not checked against the glyph table: the UI draws only ids it knows.

fields.name: default
fields.meaning: Must fit the type, the choices and the range.

fields.name: layout
fields.meaning: record: one set of fields; list: rows, each keyed by a text `name` and holding every field.

fields.name: note
fields.meaning: How the model should update it; goes into the update tool's description.

fields.name: template
fields.meaning: Macro text for the tracker's prompt line; absent means the default rendering.

fields.name: icon
fields.meaning: An icon id for the tracker itself, or for each row of a list; absent means no icon.

fields.name: changes
fields.meaning: How a reply's changes to this tracker are drawn; absent means chips. Stored only: the Messenger reads it.
